adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddingController#update`, the action simply `render_serialized(@embedding, ...)` after `fetch_embedding` builds an `OpenStruct` (id + `EmbeddableHost.all.order(:host)`) and does not read/apply any params, so a `PUT /admin/customize/embedding` would indeed be a no-op that returns 200. However, the added admin UI template (`admin/templates/embedding.hbs`) never calls `saveChanges`, and host persistence is handled via the separate `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController` (`resources :embeddable_hosts`), so this no-op endpoint appears unused/placeholder rather than a demonstrated broken feature in the diff.
